headline: Nvidia earnings tonight and FOMC minutes tomorrow headline a week where markets are pricing a possible December Fed hike amid Iran-driven oil volatility.
rates: CME FedWatch shows roughly a 96% chance of a quarter-point hike in December after hot October inflation data, keeping yields elevated.
fed: FOMC minutes from the Oct 27-28 meeting land Wednesday at 2:00 PM ET, with Fed Governor Cook speaking Friday after Chair Warsh spoke Monday.
oil: Oil fell about 5% on Nov 9 (Brent below $92) when Trump signaled restraint on Iran despite fresh shipping attacks near Hormuz, and it remains headline-driven.
geo: The Iran conflict and attacks on Gulf shipping remain the live geopolitical risk, with Trump's restraint signals driving oil swings.
